# Skills.sh

> > A curated repository of agent skills and coding standards for GitHub Copilot, AI development tools, and modern web frameworks.

Skills.sh provides structured knowledge files (SKILL.md format) that help AI coding assistants like GitHub Copilot understand project-specific patterns, coding standards, and development workflows. The platform hosts skills for frameworks like Next.js and React, cloud platforms like Azure, and development practices ranging from UI/UX design to testing and infrastructure.

## Key Topics

- GitHub Copilot
- Agent Skills
- Copilot Skills
- Coding Standards
- Next.js
- React
- Python
- MCP (Model Context Protocol)
- TypeScript/JavaScript
- CLI Tools
- Interface Design
- Azure
- Testing (JUnit)
- Terraform
- Design Systems

## Getting Started

- [skill-standardization by supercent-io/skills-template](https://skills.sh/supercent-io/skills-template/skill-standardization): Agent Skills Specification with SKILL.md structure & validation
- [find-skills by vercel-labs/skills](https://skills.sh/vercel-labs/skills/find-skills): Skills CLI tool for discovering & installing agent skills via npx
- [github-copilot-starter by github/awesome-copilot](https://skills.sh/github/awesome-copilot/github-copilot-starter): GitHub Copilot setup guide with configuration & coding standards

## GitHub Copilot Skills

- [copilot-usage-metrics by github/awesome-copilot](https://skills.sh/github/awesome-copilot/copilot-usage-metrics): GitHub Copilot usage metrics via CLI for enterprise & org statistics
- [typespec-create-agent by github/awesome-copilot](https://skills.sh/github/awesome-copilot/typespec-create-agent): TypeSpec guide for creating Microsoft 365 Copilot declarative agents
- [editorconfig by github/awesome-copilot](https://skills.sh/github/awesome-copilot/editorconfig): EditorConfig skill for consistent code style & formatting standards
- [csharp-mcp-server-generator by github/awesome-copilot](https://skills.sh/github/awesome-copilot/csharp-mcp-server-generator): C# .NET 8.0 Model Context Protocol server generator & scaffolding

## React & Next.js

- [next-cache-components by vercel-labs/next-skills](https://skills.sh/vercel-labs/next-skills/next-cache-components): Next.js 16 Cache Components & Partial Prerendering (PPR) guide
- [vercel-composition-patterns by vercel-labs/agent-skills](https://skills.sh/vercel-labs/agent-skills/vercel-composition-patterns): React 19 component composition patterns & compound components guide

## Development Environment & Tools

- [system-environment-setup by supercent-io/skills-template](https://skills.sh/supercent-io/skills-template/system-environment-setup): Docker Compose dev environment with PostgreSQL, Redis & Nginx setup
- [codebase-search by supercent-io/skills-template](https://skills.sh/supercent-io/skills-template/codebase-search): Codebase navigation with semantic search & grep pattern strategies
- [java-junit by github/awesome-copilot](https://skills.sh/github/awesome-copilot/java-junit): JUnit 5 testing guide with Maven/Gradle setup & parameterized tests

## Cloud & Infrastructure

- [azure-postgres by microsoft/github-copilot-for-azure](https://skills.sh/microsoft/github-copilot-for-azure/azure-postgres): Azure PostgreSQL with Entra ID passwordless authentication setup
- [terraform-azurerm-set-diff-analyzer by github/awesome-copilot](https://skills.sh/github/awesome-copilot/terraform-azurerm-set-diff-analyzer): Terraform AzureRM diff analyzer for detecting false positives in plans

## Design & UI/UX

- [interface-design by dammyjay93/interface-design](https://skills.sh/dammyjay93/interface-design/interface-design): SaaS interface design guide covering typography, navigation & data viz
- [responsive-design by supercent-io/skills-template](https://skills.sh/supercent-io/skills-template/responsive-design): Mobile-first responsive design with CSS Grid, Flexbox & media queries
- [penpot-uiux-design by github/awesome-copilot](https://skills.sh/github/awesome-copilot/penpot-uiux-design): Penpot UI/UX design with MCP server plugin setup & troubleshooting
